benefits.name: Disney Store & DisneyStore.com Discount
benefits.description: 10% off select purchases at DisneyStore.com and Disney Store locations.
benefits.terms: Select merchandise only. Excludes sales tax, shipping, gift wrap, Disney Gift Cards, and various licensed brands (see full exclusion list in card terms).

benefits.name: Disney Parks Merchandise Discount
benefits.description: 10% off select merchandise purchases at select locations at Disneyland Resort and Walt Disney World Resort.

benefits.name: Complimentary DashPass Membership
benefits.description: 12 months of complimentary DashPass membership from DoorDash, plus a quarterly non-restaurant order credit.
benefits.terms: Requires activation between Feb. 1, 2025 and Dec. 31, 2027 per current promotion. Auto-enrolls at current monthly rates after the complimentary period. Also includes up to $10 off quarterly on non-restaurant DoorDash orders through Dec. 31, 2027; confirm these dates are still current before relying on them.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers new purchases against damage or theft for 120 days, up to $500 per item.
benefits.terms: 90-day coverage period for New York residents.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of 3 years or less by an additional year.

earningRates.terms: Earns Disney Rewards Dollars, redeemable at Disney locations, DisneyStore.com, and toward select airline/vacation purchases. No limit to amount earned.
